title: FBS - Product Owner III
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.
About the Role
We are looking for a Product Owner to lead product development initiatives within an Agile environment, managing backlog priorities, driving delivery execution, and ensuring solutions align with business goals and customer needs.
This role acts as the bridge between stakeholders, business teams, and engineering, helping shape product strategy, improve digital customer journeys, and deliver measurable business value.
What You’ll Do

• Own and manage a well-groomed, outcome-driven product backlog aligned to business strategy.

• Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria tied to measurable outcomes.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to balance speed, quality, and sustainability.

• Prioritize features and manage dependencies to optimize delivery and business value.

• Lead Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder alignment activities.

• Monitor product progress, mitigate risks, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Use quantitative data and analytics to drive product decisions, prioritization, and tradeoffs.

• Improve digital customer experiences and conversion flows, including quote-to-bind and self-service journeys.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders, Product Managers, and development teams.

• Support demos, testing, iteration planning, and release execution.

• Mentor junior Product Owners and contribute to Agile best practices.

Requirements

• Experience working as a Product Owner in Agile / SAFe / Scrum environments.

• Experience improving digital customer journeys and online conversion flows.

• Background working with product analytics, experimentation, and backlog management.

• Familiarity with regulated environments is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Fluent English required.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to use data to drive decisions and prioritization.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience balancing business needs, customer experience, and technical constraints.

• Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics.

• Experimentation & A/B Testing tools.

• Design & collaboration tools such as Figma, Miro, and Lucid.

Benefits
Competitive compensation and benefits package:

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Career development and training opportunities

• Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)

• Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

• Private Health Insurance

• Pension Plan

• Paid Time Off

• Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: Middle Affiliate Manager
description:

Honeytech - це динамічний, швидкозростаючий проєкт, що вже займає одну з лідерських позицій у світі вебкоміксів. За останні 3 роки ми зібрали команду сильних спеціалістів, з якими виросли у 10+ разів та плануємо вирости ще втричі цього року, тому саме зараз шукаємо нового амбітного та проактивного колегу. Вже зараз ми займаємо провідні позиції за обсягом трафіку, і попереду - ще більші цілі!
Що чекає на тебе з нами?

• 📈 Реальний вплив на розвиток affiliate-напрямку: ти не просто працюватимеш із партнерами, а зможеш впливати на розвиток процесів, запускати нові ініціативи, знаходити додаткові точки росту та разом із командою масштабувати напрямок.

• 🚀 Можливість швидкого кар'єрного зростання: ми активно масштабуємо affiliate-напрямок, тому тут є простір для розвитку, розширення зони відповідальності та кар’єрного росту разом із бізнесом.

• 🧠 Сильна команда однодумців: співпрацюй з досвідченими фахівцями, які мають сильну експертизу в перфоманс маркетингу, дата аналітиці, розвитку діджитал продуктів та у створенні візуального контенту.
🤩Пряма комунікація та прозорі процеси: ми любимо здоровий глузд більше, ніж заплутані процедури та уникаємо зайву бюрократію.

• 📊 Аналітика на вищому рівні: маємо налаштовану систему аналітичних репортів, що дозволяє приймати data-driven рішення правильно та своєчасно.

Наш ідеальний Affiliate Manager має:
- 2+ роки досвіду в Affiliate Marketing;
- Досвід роботи з affiliate-партнерами: пошук, онбординг, розвиток та масштабування;
- Хороше розуміння трекінгу (створення офферів, налаштування postback, attribution models);
- Розуміння різних джерел трафіку (social, native, push, pop, search тощо);
- Вміння аналізувати ефективність партнерів через EPC, CR, CPA, ROI.
- Англійська на рівні B2+ для роботи з міжнародними партнерами;
Твоя зона відповідальності:
- Пошук, залучення та розвиток affiliate-партнерів: ресерч, переговори, онбординг і побудова довгострокових відносин.
- Супровід партнерів: допомога із запуском, робота з оферами, лінками, трекінгом і вирішення поточних питань.
- Аналіз ефективності партнерів: моніторинг ключових метрик (CR, EPC, CPA тощо), пошук точок росту та масштабування.
- Контроль якості трафіку, коректності трекінгу та дотримання домовленостей.
- Ведення CRM, звітності та документації, щоб усі процеси залишались прозорими й структурованими.
- Тісна взаємодія з командами аналітики, дизайну та розробки для запуску й розвитку партнерських інтеграцій.
- Використання AI та сучасних інструментів для ресерчу, автоматизації процесів, комунікації та підвищення ефективності роботи.

title: Data Scientist for Top Cosmetic firm
description:
Headquarters:

Summary
We are seeking a Data Scientist to analyze anonymized consumer interaction data and uncover patterns in unstructured language across call center and cross-channel conversations. The primary goal is to identify intent, surface trends, and turn language into structured insights that can inform content strategy and web experiences.
General information
This engagement focuses on a large historical dataset collected over 10 years across consumer information and interaction touchpoints. The data includes call center and cross-channel interactions, with existing KPI reporting around areas such as conflict types and call duration, but limited analysis of the underlying unstructured language.
The data sits in a homegrown database and Azure environment, with an anonymized semantic layer. The initial phase will be exploratory and somewhat open-ended, starting with manual exports of conversation data before more connected pipelines are established. This role will work closely with a Program Manager supporting the broader effort.

Tasks and Deliverables
- Analyze anonymized consumer interaction and call center conversation data.
- Review exported conversation data across channels, brands, and interaction types.
- Identify intent patterns within unstructured language and conversation content.
- Spot trends in customer language not captured by existing KPI reporting.
- Convert unstructured language into structured insights and usable analysis frameworks.
- Develop recommendations on how findings can inform content strategy.
- Explore how LLM-era language analysis can support web content decisions.
- Collaborate closely with the paired Program

title: Investigating Manager - Adults MASH
description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Investigating Manager for its client's Adults MASH Team at Wiltshire.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled safeguarding professional to work within a specialist multi-agency environment supporting adults who are at risk of, or have experienced, harm and who have care and support needs.

The Adult MASH works closely with a wide range of partner agencies including Police, Children's Services, Health professionals, CQC, Advocacy services, voluntary organisations, and care providers to ensure safeguarding concerns are assessed and managed effectively. The successful candidate will play a key role in overseeing safeguarding investigations, managing risk, and ensuring that the principles of Making Safeguarding Personal remain central to all interventions.

This role requires an experienced practitioner with extensive safeguarding knowledge, excellent decision-making skills, and the ability to provide professional advice and oversight across complex safeguarding enquiries.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Acting as Investigating Manager for Section 42 safeguarding enquiries, maintaining oversight from initial referral through to conclusion.

• Establishing safeguarding thresholds, setting investigation actions, agreeing minutes, and ensuring all enquiries progress appropriately and within required timescales.

• Monitoring safeguarding investigations to ensure outcomes are clearly identified, completed, and actioned effectively.

• Undertaking the role of Investigating Officer for complex safeguarding enquiries, including those involving care homes, supported living services, hospital wards, and provider concerns.

• Triaging safeguarding referrals, assessing risk, and determining appropriate safeguarding responses in accordance with legislation and local safeguarding procedures.

• Providing specialist advice and guidance on safeguarding adults, Mental Capacity Act, Human Rights, and safeguarding processes to practitioners and partner agencies.

• Working collaboratively within a multi-agency environment, liaising with Police, Health professionals, CQC, Advocacy services, Children's Services, and provider organisations.

• Applying the principles of Making Safeguarding Personal to ensure adults remain at the centre of all safeguarding processes and decision-making.

• Supporting quality assurance and service improvement activities to promote best practice across safeguarding services.

• Assisting with the development of colleagues through training, mentoring, professional guidance, and promoting high-quality safeguarding practice.

• Maintaining accurate records, safeguarding documentation, reports, and correspondence to a high professional standard.

• Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support positive outcomes for adults at risk.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, Occupational Therapy qualification, or equivalent recognised professional qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England or the relevant professional regulatory body.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care, Adult Safeguarding, or a related specialist setting.

• Safeguarding Experience: Extensive experience leading and overseeing safeguarding investigations involving adults at risk.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Human Rights Act, safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Investigation Skills: Proven ability to undertake complex investigations, analyse information, assess risk, and make defensible professional decisions.

• Multi-Agency Working: Experience working effectively with Police, Health Services, CQC, Advocacy Services, and other safeguarding partners.

ABOUT US

Our mission: Eradicate health disparities by empowering the teams who care for underserved families.

BridgeHealthAI partners with Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) and community organizations to ensure every patient gets the care and benefits they deserve without drowning care teams in paperwork.

Our platform automates high-friction tasks like outreach, insurance verification, eligibility checks, follow-ups, referrals, and scheduling. With modern AI and automation, we help teams close care gaps faster, protect revenue, reduce administrative burden, and stay focused on patients.

Born out of Harvard and MIT and backed by Pear VC, Flare Capital, and Glen Tullman (founder of Livongo), BridgeHealthAI is a fast-growing, seed-stage company trusted by leading community health centers. We're looking for a Product Manager with 5+ years of product management experience and meaningful experience in healthcare or health tech to help us turn complex healthcare operations into simple, scalable products.

This is a highly hands-on, customer-facing product role. You'll work directly with health center executives, frontline teams, engineers, operations, and the founders to deeply understand problems, identify what we should build, and drive products from discovery through launch and iteration.

title: Wargaming Research & Systems Analyst — Red Cell Lead

tags: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maneuver Dominance Engineering : MD - Advanced Capabilities
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

At Anduril, we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface, surface, land, and air domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of multi-mission capability to our customers. In addition to the physical systems being produced, Anduril is providing training and experimentation services to our partners and customers. These projects require Warfighting Systems Analysts who can connect operational needs to system architecture, technical performance, integration choices, and mission-level outcomes. We are looking for our next Lead Warfighting Systems Analyst to join our rapidly growing team in Abu Dhabi, UAE . Initial hiring will be in London, UK and the candidate will relocate upon initial completion of the simulation center.

The Lead Warfighting Systems Analyst is responsible for producing, iterating, and supporting Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (M&SA) including wargaming and experimentation for Anduril products. This has a three-fold purpose: Train the customer in Anduril capabilities, conduct internal analysis to support the iterative improvement of current and future products, and learn the specific customers’ needs to ensure we produce the right product for the right reasons. The Lead Warfighter Systems Analyst will be the first hire and lead role in an extremely Agile team of wargaming analysts who will be the plank owners of a new simulation center being built in the UAE.

This role is ideal for individuals who can reason across military operations and technical systems, evaluate performance tradeoffs, develop and deploy scenarios with Python and YAML, and communicate how system design decisions affect operational utility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Leverage high-end models and simulations, including Anduril's Lattice Mission Simulation (MissionSim) to conduct simulation, experimentation, and training

• Develop scenarios based on customer needs to demonstrate capabilities

• Support engineering and product teams by evaluating how platform, payload, autonomy, sensor, effector, communications, navigation, or C2 choices affect mission outcomes

• Design, execute, and analyze tactical (engagement-level and mission-level) analysis and wargames to assess autonomous system capabilities and refine tactics

• Develop physics-based models and relevant operational scenarios, with an emphasis on modeling red and blue force systems and tactics

• Assess system-of-systems interactions, integration risks, dependencies, constraints, and mission impacts

• Lead the warfighting capability analysts to ensure system analysis remains grounded in real operational problems and customer needs

• Collaborate with engineering and business development teams to demonstrate Anduril's capabilities and value proposition through rigorous, data-driven analysis

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Currently possess and be able to maintain an active country specific Secret security clearance

• 7+ years of experience in Operations Research, Systems Analysis (ORSA), systems engineering, mission engineering, test and evaluation, or a related technical-operational discipline

• Experience with tactical experiments and wargaming design, including scenario development, data analytics, and trade-space analysis

title: Account Executive
description:
ABOUT ENODE

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode https://enode.com provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect https://enode.com/connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation https://enode.com/optimize tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex https://enode.com/flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI IS FUNDAMENTAL TO HOW WE WORK

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We're hiring an Account Executive to close enterprise deals with energy retailers, and turn their customers EVs, heat pumps and batteries into flexible capacity the grid can actually use.

Every retailer in Europe knows they need to do this. Very few have done it yet. The distance between a board approving a smart charging proposition and a customer plugging in at three in the morning because the price is low is where this role sits, and it gets closed by someone who can carry the commercial case and the technical one in the same conversation. Six months from now, this seat should mean every qualified opportunity in your markets has one person accountable for it, and the pattern of what actually wins is written down rather than held in someone's head.

You'll report to Enode's VP of Revenue, who leads sales, customer success, customer engineering, marketing and partnerships. We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)

Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist , you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

 

You will work in founder and product mode : you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

• Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them:  You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

• Build and operate AI agents as products:  You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

• Knowledge and context management:  You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

• Evaluation and quality assurance:  You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

• CRM and data integration:  You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

• Central interface and enablement:  You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

• Impact and measurement:  Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone . What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.

• Learning speed and a production mindset:  You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.

• An instinct for evaluation:  You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.
